title: Update old post and sim test paths in code comments after the suite fold

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:low
labels.description: Mechanical, one file, no new logic (issue-worker-low)

body:
The fix for #3188 moves the post and sim integration tests into directory suites. Some code comments and fixture headers still name the old flat paths. Update them to the new paths:

- `crates/post/src/post/upright_after_tilt.rs:12`: `crates/post/tests/upright_after_tilt.rs` -> `crates/post/tests/script_rotary/upright_after_tilt.rs`
- `crates/app/tests/folder_lists.rs:5`: `crates/post/tests/folder_scan.rs` -> `crates/post/tests/post_engine/folder_scan.rs`
- `crates/app/tests/recorded_post_streams.rs:12`: `crates/post/tests/recorded_streams.rs` -> `crates/post/tests/script_goldens/recorded_streams.rs`
- `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs:158`: `crates/post/tests/script_sinker_iso.rs` -> `crates/post/tests/script_goldens/script_sinker_iso.rs`
- `crates/app/tests/contour_arc_sim.rs:11`: `crates/sim/tests/arc_sweep.rs` -> `crates/sim/tests/stock_engines/arc_sweep.rs`
- `crates/app/tests/wall_column_gouge.rs:8`: `crates/sim/tests/wall_slack.rs` -> `crates/sim/tests/gouge_laws/wall_slack.rs`
- `crates/gcode/tests/klartext/round_trip.rs:8`: `crates/post/tests/script_heidenhain_klartext.rs` -> `crates/post/tests/script_goldens/script_heidenhain_klartext.rs`
- `crates/gpu/tests/fixtures/cut_twin_ball_2627.txt:2` and `cut_twin_flat_2627.txt:2`: `crates/sim/tests/stock_cut_twin.rs` -> `crates/sim/tests/stock_engines/stock_cut_twin.rs`

The PR for #3188 did not edit these files. A comment change in `crates/post/src` put about 70 app suites into the quick gate of that PR.

Do this after the PR for #3188 merges. Only comments change, so no behaviour changes.
